metadata.description: A collection of Claude Code mods

plugins.name: usage-meter
plugins.description: Directory, branch, worktree, model and effort, with 5h and weekly limits (subscription) or cost (pay-per-token), above the prompt; context below it

plugins.name: context-weather
plugins.description: A lo-fi pixel weather window whose sky follows the context: clear when it is empty, a thunderstorm when it is full, and day or night by your clock
